figures.caption: Figure 6. Surface-referenced band-edge alignment of the five retained FIB electrolyte candidates and the PbSnF4 reference relative to the vacuum level (0 eV), from HSE06 calculations on (001) slab models. Orange and blue bars represent the CBM and VBM, respectively. The F2/F- redox level is located at -7.33 eV, and the hypothetical 4 V anode level at -3.33 eV. The comparison is an electronic band-alignment descriptor and not a complete thermodynamic electrochemical stability window.
